title: Sales agent: recommended lead and opportunity actions in Microsoft 365 Copilot
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, Sales agent licensing and documented controls are supported. It correctly distinguishes the planned Microsoft 365 experience from the documented Dynamics 365 capability. The tenant access path stops on the correct settings pane but should identify the Microsoft 365 Copilot toggle.
